title: On Advising a long rest in the hills
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：advise　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the keeper ① advised a long rest in the hills with great care, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② advises a long rest in the hills on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ advise a long rest in the hills at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ advised a long rest in the hills before — a line in the register for March 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Advising a long rest in the hills with great care, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ advise them against the journey on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Advise them against the journey at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ advises them against the journey with great care every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply  advised a long rest in the hills again when nobody else would.

To advise a long rest in the hills, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody advises a long rest in the hills on the same day again and somebody must advise a long rest in the hills with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 建议（一般过去式 advised a long rest in the hills：1960 年饲养员头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 建议（一般现在 advises a long rest in the hills：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 建议（不定式 to advise a long rest in the hills：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 建议（过去完成时 had advised a long rest in the hills：1954 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 建议（动名词 advising a long rest in the hills 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 劝告（advise them against the journey：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去劝告劝他们别走那一趟）
G. v. 劝告（advise them against the journey：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 建议（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 advises them against the journey，而母亲又一次 advised a long rest in the hills）

answers.why: advise 意为“建议”，1960 年饲养员小心翼翼地建议到山里好好歇一阵，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 advised。
advise 意为“建议”，自那以后饲养员当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 advises。
advise 意为“建议”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯建议到山里好好歇一阵”，此处为不定式 to advise a long rest in the hills。
advise 意为“建议”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1967 年之前就有人建议过，故用过去完成时 had advised。
advise 意为“建议”，饲养员说“建议到山里好好歇一阵这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 advising a long rest in the hills 作主语。
advise 意为“劝告”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去劝告劝他们别走那一趟”，should ever 之后用原形 advise them against the journey。
advise 意为“劝告”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻劝告劝他们别走那一趟（advise them against the journey at once），以后再也不要提起。
advise 意为“建议”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例劝告劝他们别走那一趟，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 advises。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，饲养员小心翼翼地建议到山里好好歇一阵；兽舍里每一个孩子都说这是头一回。（advised a long rest in the hills）
多年以后，饲养员仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（advises a long rest in the hills）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯建议到山里好好歇一阵这件事本身。（to advise a long rest in the hills）
早在 1954 年就有人建议到山里好好歇一阵，三月那天饲养台账上的一行字就是证据。（had advised a long rest in the hills）
饲养员说过，小心翼翼地建议到山里好好歇一阵这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（advising a long rest in the hills 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻劝告劝他们别走那一趟，以后再也不要提起。（advise them against the journey，祈使句）

Somebody had advised a long rest in the hills long before 1967, and the line in the register for March proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 advise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the keeper advised a long rest in the hills with great care, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper advises a long rest in the hills on the same day whenever the zoo asks.
Advising a long rest in the hills with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever advise them against the journey on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo advises them against the journey with great care every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother advised a long rest in the hills again, and the zoo remembered that half.
